dishes.name: Ruhr Frikadelle
dishes.desc: Large fried minced-meat patty, eaten hot with potato salad or in a roll. A miners-era staple of Ruhr home cooking and snack bars.

dishes.name: Pommes Schranke
dishes.desc: Chips with both ketchup and mayonnaise, the red-white Ruhr order named after the railway barrier.

dishes.name: Panhas
dishes.desc: Fried slices of a buckwheat and pork-broth sausage, a Westphalian and Lower Rhine speciality of the Ruhr.

dishes.name: Mettbrötchen
dishes.desc: Crusty roll with seasoned raw minced pork and onions, a classic Ruhr breakfast and bakery order.
